resolution: Diagnosed why the WORKFREEZE fix was faster but not fully fixed: the first patch removed duplicate dynamic geometry shipments, dropping /workbench mount hostFlush from ~712MB to later traces around 29.6MB, but /workbench still cold-mounts a fresh Scene3D character stage with unique Globe geometry. The remaining hang is the transport path: real first-use vertex buffers are still serialized as decimal JSON arrays through __hostFlush, then copied and parsed in v8_app.zig before the host retained-geometry cache can help. No code change was completed for this second-stage fix because the turn was interrupted; the next targeted fix is to pack scene3dVertices/height buffers before hostFlush or move Globe generation host-side.
